This module supplies a Lean-native mathematical analogue of the finite-prefix,
overlap, gluing, and recurrence constructions in `research/rh_pl01/`. Its domain
is Lean's `Nat`, and its graphs are predicates or functions. It does not translate
the custom Hilbert calculus, its set-theoretic encoding, or its frozen RH target.

The operation arguments `mul` and `add` are arbitrary total natural functions.
The general theorems impose no arithmetic laws on them. The final numerical
witnesses specialize both operations to Lean's natural multiplication and addition.

The marker comments delimit declarations for the proof-repair gym. A challenge
receives the declarations preceding its target and the target's statement.

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FeedbackChannel.RHCompactification

universe u
variable {α : Type u}

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit
/-- Primitive recursion with a step indexed by its predecessor. -/
def orbit (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) : Nat → α
  | 0 => seed
  | n + 1 => step n (orbit step seed n)
-- RHGYM-END orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN IsPrefix
/-- A recurrence contract through `bound`; values after `bound` are unrestricted. -/
def IsPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ i, i < bound → f (i + 1) = step i (f i)
-- RHGYM-END IsPrefix

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend
/-- Replace the next point while retaining every earlier value. -/
def extend (f : Nat → α) (bound : Nat) (value : α) : Nat → α :=
  fun i => if i = bound + 1 then value else f i
-- RHGYM-END extend

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend_at_new
theorem extend_at_new (f : Nat → α) (bound : Nat) (value : α) :
    extend f bound value (bound + 1) = value := by
  simp [extend]
-- RHGYM-END extend_at_new

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend_before
theorem extend_before (f : Nat → α) (bound i : Nat) (value : α)
    (hi : i ≤ bound) : extend f bound value i = f i := by
  have hne : i ≠ bound + 1 := Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi)
  simp [extend, hne]
-- RHGYM-END extend_before

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_zero
theorem prefix_zero (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    IsPrefix step seed 0 (fun _ => seed) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_restrict
theorem prefix_restrict {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {m n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hmn : m ≤ n) : IsPrefix step seed m f := by
  refine ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hmn)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_restrict

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_extend
theorem prefix_extend {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) :
    IsPrefix step seed (n + 1) (extend f n (step n (f n))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [extend_before f n 0 (step n (f n)) (Nat.zero_le n)]
    exact hf.1
  · intro i hi
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi) with hlt | heq
    · rw [extend_before f n (i + 1) (step n (f n)) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt)]
      rw [extend_before f n i (step n (f n)) (Nat.le_of_lt hlt)]
      exact hf.2 i hlt
    · subst i
      rw [extend_at_new, extend_before f n n (step n (f n)) (Nat.le_refl n)]
-- RHGYM-END prefix_extend

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_agreement
/-- Independently chosen prefixes agree at every index in both domains. -/
theorem prefix_agreement {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n m : Nat}
    {f g : Nat → α} (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hg : IsPrefix step seed m g)
    (i : Nat) (hin : i ≤ n) (him : i ≤ m) : f i = g i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ i ih =>
      rw [hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hin), hg.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le him)]
      exact congrArg (step i)
        (ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) hin) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) him))
-- RHGYM-END prefix_agreement

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_isPrefix
theorem orbit_isPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    IsPrefix step seed n (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_isPrefix

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_eq_orbit
theorem prefix_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) : f i = orbit step seed i := by
  exact prefix_agreement hf (orbit_isPrefix step seed n) i hi hi
-- RHGYM-END prefix_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_exists
/-- Finite existence follows by repeated checked extension. -/
theorem prefix_exists (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, IsPrefix step seed n f := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => seed, prefix_zero step seed⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨extend f n (step n (f n)), prefix_extend hf⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_exists

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixGraph
/-- A graph predicate whose domain is exactly the finite initial segment. -/
def PrefixGraph (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  i ≤ bound ∧ value = f i
-- RHGYM-END PrefixGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_domain
theorem prefix_graph_domain (bound i : Nat) (f : Nat → α) :
    (∃ value, PrefixGraph bound f i value) ↔ i ≤ bound := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨value, hv⟩ := h
    exact hv.1
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨f i, hi, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_domain

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_functional
theorem prefix_graph_functional {bound i : Nat} {f : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (ha : PrefixGraph bound f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph bound f i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans hb.2.symm
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_functional

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_overlap
theorem prefix_graph_overlap {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n m i : Nat}
    {f g : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hg : IsPrefix step seed m g)
    (ha : PrefixGraph n f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph m g i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans ((prefix_agreement hf hg i ha.1 hb.1).trans hb.2.symm)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_overlap

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixFamily
/-- The family supplies an explicit prefix at every endpoint. -/
def PrefixFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :=
  (n : Nat) → {f : Nat → α // IsPrefix step seed n f}
-- RHGYM-END PrefixFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN canonicalFamily
def canonicalFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) : PrefixFamily step seed :=
  fun n => ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_isPrefix step seed n⟩
-- RHGYM-END canonicalFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue
/-- The diagonal chooses the endpoint value of the corresponding prefix. -/
def glue {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : Nat → α :=
  fun i => (family i).val i
-- RHGYM-END glue

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_agrees
theorem glue_agrees {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    glue family i = (family n).val i := by
  exact prefix_agreement (family i).property (family n).property i (Nat.le_refl i) hi
-- RHGYM-END glue_agrees

-- RHGYM-BEGIN GluedGraph
/-- Union of the bounded graph predicates supplied by a prefix family. -/
def GluedGraph {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ n, PrefixGraph n (family n).val i value
-- RHGYM-END GluedGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glued_graph_iff
theorem glued_graph_iff {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) :
    GluedGraph family i value ↔ value = glue family i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
    exact hn.2.trans (glue_agrees family n i hn.1).symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨i, Nat.le_refl i, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END glued_graph_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_zero
theorem glue_zero {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family 0 = seed := by
  exact (family 0).property.1
-- RHGYM-END glue_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_succ
theorem glue_succ {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n : Nat) :
    glue family (n + 1) = step n (glue family n) := by
  calc
    glue family (n + 1) = step n ((family (n + 1)).val n) :=
      (family (n + 1)).property.2 n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    _ = step n (glue family n) :=
      congrArg (step n) (glue_agrees family (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)).symm
-- RHGYM-END glue_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN Recurrence
/-- The unrestricted recurrence contract. -/
def Recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ n, f (n + 1) = step n (f n)
-- RHGYM-END Recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_recurrence
theorem orbit_recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    Recurrence step seed (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_unique
theorem recurrence_unique {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {f g : Nat → α}
    (hf : Recurrence step seed f) (hg : Recurrence step seed g) : f = g := by
  funext n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [hf.2 n, hg.2 n, ih]
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_exists_unique
theorem recurrence_exists_unique (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed f ∧
      ∀ g : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed g → g = f := by
  exact ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_recurrence step seed,
    fun _ hg => recurrence_unique hg (orbit_recurrence step seed)⟩
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_exists_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_eq_orbit
theorem glue_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family = orbit step seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨glue_zero family, glue_succ family⟩ (orbit_recurrence step seed)
-- RHGYM-END glue_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator
def denominator (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  orbit (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed
-- RHGYM-END denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_zero
theorem denominator_zero (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed 0 = seed := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_succ
theorem denominator_succ (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed n : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (denominator mul seed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_unique
theorem denominator_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) :
    f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN ExactDenominatorStep
/-- Existential evaluation order analogous to frozen clause 21. -/
def ExactDenominatorStep (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, ∃ k a l b c : Nat,
    k = n + 1 ∧ a = f k ∧ l = n + 1 ∧ b = f n ∧ c = mul l b ∧ a = c
-- RHGYM-END ExactDenominatorStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_to_exact
theorem denominator_step_to_exact {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) : ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  intro n
  exact ⟨n + 1, f (n + 1), n + 1, f n, f (n + 1), rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hs n, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_to_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_to_step
theorem denominator_exact_to_step {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨k, a, l, b, c, hk, ha, hl, hb, hc, hac⟩ := h n
  calc
    f (n + 1) = f k := congrArg f hk.symm
    _ = a := ha.symm
    _ = c := hac
    _ = mul l b := hc
    _ = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by rw [hl, hb]
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_to_step

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_equiv
theorem denominator_step_equiv (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    (∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) ↔ ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  exact ⟨denominator_step_to_exact, denominator_exact_to_step⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_equiv

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact
theorem denominator_exact (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    ExactDenominatorStep mul (denominator mul seed) := by
  exact denominator_step_to_exact (denominator_succ mul seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_unique
theorem denominator_exact_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact denominator_unique h0 (denominator_exact_to_step hs)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN jointStep
def jointStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (state : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  (add (mul (n + 1) state.1) state.2, mul (n + 1) state.2)
-- RHGYM-END jointStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint
/-- Joint numerator and denominator recurrence with independent initial values. -/
def joint (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat :=
  orbit (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed)
-- RHGYM-END joint

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator
def numerator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) : Nat :=
  (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1
-- RHGYM-END numerator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_zero
theorem joint_zero (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed 0 = (numSeed, denSeed) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_succ
theorem joint_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      jointStep mul add n (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_denominator
theorem joint_denominator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have h : (fun i => (joint mul add numSeed denSeed i).2) = denominator mul denSeed :=
    denominator_unique rfl (fun _ => rfl)
  exact congrFun h n
-- RHGYM-END joint_denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator_succ
theorem numerator_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    numerator mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      add (mul (n + 1) (numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n)) (denominator mul denSeed n) := by
  change add (mul (n + 1) (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1)
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = _
  rw [joint_denominator]
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END numerator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_unique
theorem joint_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {f : Nat → Nat × Nat} (h0 : f 0 = (numSeed, denSeed))
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = jointStep mul add n (f n)) :
    f = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed))
-- RHGYM-END joint_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_components_unique
theorem joint_components_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {a b : Nat → Nat} (ha0 : a 0 = numSeed) (hb0 : b 0 = denSeed)
    (ha : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = add (mul (n + 1) (a n)) (b n))
    (hb : ∀ n, b (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (b n)) :
    ∀ n, a n = numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n ∧ b n = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have hpair : (fun n => (a n, b n)) = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
    apply joint_unique
    · exact Prod.ext ha0 hb0
    · intro n
      exact Prod.ext (ha n) (hb n)
  intro n
  have atN := congrFun hpair n
  refine ⟨congrArg Prod.fst atN, ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg Prod.snd atN).trans (joint_denominator mul add numSeed denSeed n)
-- RHGYM-END joint_components_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN witness_denominator_six
/-- A concrete finite witness, checked by kernel reduction. -/
theorem witness_denominator_six : denominator Nat.mul 1 6 = 720 := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END witness_denominator_six

-- RHGYM-BEGIN witness_joint_six
/-- The integer numerator/denominator recurrence at index six. -/
theorem witness_joint_six : joint Nat.mul Nat.add 0 1 6 = (1764, 720) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END witness_joint_six

This module extends the recurrence curriculum using only the existing
`RHCompactification` module and its `Init` dependencies. The operation arguments

-- RHGYM-BEGIN AffineStep
/-- Relational evaluation, including the identity branch at index zero. -/
def AffineStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (y a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  (y = 0 ∧ b = a) ∨
    ∃ x d u : Nat, y = x + 1 ∧ d = den x ∧ u = mul y a ∧ b = add u d
-- RHGYM-END AffineStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affineValue
/-- The total function represented by `AffineStep`. -/
def affineValue (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, a => a
  | x + 1, a => add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x)
-- RHGYM-END affineValue

      rw [hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hin), hg.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le him)]
      exact congrArg (step i)
        (ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) hin) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) him))
-- RHGYM-END prefix_agreement

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_isPrefix
theorem orbit_isPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    IsPrefix step seed n (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_isPrefix

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_eq_orbit
theorem prefix_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) : f i = orbit step seed i := by
  exact prefix_agreement hf (orbit_isPrefix step seed n) i hi hi
-- RHGYM-END prefix_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_exists
/-- Finite existence follows by repeated checked extension. -/
theorem prefix_exists (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, IsPrefix step seed n f := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => seed, prefix_zero step seed⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨extend f n (step n (f n)), prefix_extend hf⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_exists

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixGraph
/-- A graph predicate whose domain is exactly the finite initial segment. -/
def PrefixGraph (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  i ≤ bound ∧ value = f i
-- RHGYM-END PrefixGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_domain
theorem prefix_graph_domain (bound i : Nat) (f : Nat → α) :
    (∃ value, PrefixGraph bound f i value) ↔ i ≤ bound := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨value, hv⟩ := h
    exact hv.1
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨f i, hi, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_domain

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_functional
theorem prefix_graph_functional {bound i : Nat} {f : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (ha : PrefixGraph bound f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph bound f i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans hb.2.symm
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_functional

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_overlap
theorem prefix_graph_overlap {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n m i : Nat}
    {f g : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hg : IsPrefix step seed m g)
    (ha : PrefixGraph n f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph m g i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans ((prefix_agreement hf hg i ha.1 hb.1).trans hb.2.symm)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_overlap

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixFamily
/-- The family supplies an explicit prefix at every endpoint. -/
def PrefixFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :=
  (n : Nat) → {f : Nat → α // IsPrefix step seed n f}
-- RHGYM-END PrefixFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN canonicalFamily
def canonicalFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) : PrefixFamily step seed :=
  fun n => ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_isPrefix step seed n⟩
-- RHGYM-END canonicalFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue
/-- The diagonal chooses the endpoint value of the corresponding prefix. -/
def glue {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : Nat → α :=
  fun i => (family i).val i
-- RHGYM-END glue

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_agrees
theorem glue_agrees {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    glue family i = (family n).val i := by
  exact prefix_agreement (family i).property (family n).property i (Nat.le_refl i) hi
-- RHGYM-END glue_agrees

-- RHGYM-BEGIN GluedGraph
/-- Union of the bounded graph predicates supplied by a prefix family. -/
def GluedGraph {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ n, PrefixGraph n (family n).val i value
-- RHGYM-END GluedGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glued_graph_iff
theorem glued_graph_iff {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) :
    GluedGraph family i value ↔ value = glue family i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
    exact hn.2.trans (glue_agrees family n i hn.1).symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨i, Nat.le_refl i, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END glued_graph_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_zero
theorem glue_zero {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family 0 = seed := by
  exact (family 0).property.1
-- RHGYM-END glue_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_succ
theorem glue_succ {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n : Nat) :
    glue family (n + 1) = step n (glue family n) := by
  calc
    glue family (n + 1) = step n ((family (n + 1)).val n) :=
      (family (n + 1)).property.2 n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    _ = step n (glue family n) :=
      congrArg (step n) (glue_agrees family (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)).symm
-- RHGYM-END glue_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN Recurrence
/-- The unrestricted recurrence contract. -/
def Recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ n, f (n + 1) = step n (f n)
-- RHGYM-END Recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_recurrence
theorem orbit_recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    Recurrence step seed (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_unique
theorem recurrence_unique {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {f g : Nat → α}
    (hf : Recurrence step seed f) (hg : Recurrence step seed g) : f = g := by
  funext n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [hf.2 n, hg.2 n, ih]
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_exists_unique

    ∃ f : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed f ∧
      ∀ g : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed g → g = f := by
  exact ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_recurrence step seed,
    fun _ hg => recurrence_unique hg (orbit_recurrence step seed)⟩

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_eq_orbit

  exact recurrence_unique ⟨glue_zero family, glue_succ family⟩ (orbit_recurrence step seed)
-- RHGYM-END glue_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator

theorem denominator_zero (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed 0 = seed := by
  rfl

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_succ
theorem denominator_succ (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed n : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (denominator mul seed n) := by

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_unique
theorem denominator_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) :
    f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN ExactDenominatorStep
/-- Existential evaluation order analogous to frozen clause 21. -/
def ExactDenominatorStep (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, ∃ k a l b c : Nat,
    k = n + 1 ∧ a = f k ∧ l = n + 1 ∧ b = f n ∧ c = mul l b ∧ a = c
-- RHGYM-END ExactDenominatorStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_to_exact
theorem denominator_step_to_exact {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) : ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  intro n
  exact ⟨n + 1, f (n + 1), n + 1, f n, f (n + 1), rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hs n, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_to_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_to_step

    (h : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨k, a, l, b, c, hk, ha, hl, hb, hc, hac⟩ := h n
  calc
    f (n + 1) = f k := congrArg f hk.symm
    _ = a := ha.symm
    _ = c := hac
    _ = mul l b := hc
    _ = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by rw [hl, hb]
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_to_step

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_equiv
theorem denominator_step_equiv (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    (∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) ↔ ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  exact ⟨denominator_step_to_exact, denominator_exact_to_step⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_equiv

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact
theorem denominator_exact (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    ExactDenominatorStep mul (denominator mul seed) := by
  exact denominator_step_to_exact (denominator_succ mul seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_unique
theorem denominator_exact_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact denominator_unique h0 (denominator_exact_to_step hs)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN jointStep
def jointStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (state : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  (add (mul (n + 1) state.1) state.2, mul (n + 1) state.2)
-- RHGYM-END jointStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint
/-- Joint numerator and denominator recurrence with independent initial values. -/
def joint (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat :=
  orbit (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed)
-- RHGYM-END joint

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator
def numerator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) : Nat :=
  (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1
-- RHGYM-END numerator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_zero
theorem joint_zero (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed 0 = (numSeed, denSeed) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_succ
theorem joint_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      jointStep mul add n (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_denominator
theorem joint_denominator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have h : (fun i => (joint mul add numSeed denSeed i).2) = denominator mul denSeed :=
    denominator_unique rfl (fun _ => rfl)
  exact congrFun h n
-- RHGYM-END joint_denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator_succ
theorem numerator_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    numerator mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      add (mul (n + 1) (numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n)) (denominator mul denSeed n) := by
  change add (mul (n + 1) (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1)
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = _
  rw [joint_denominator]
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END numerator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_unique
theorem joint_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {f : Nat → Nat × Nat} (h0 : f 0 = (numSeed, denSeed))
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = jointStep mul add n (f n)) :
    f = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed))
-- RHGYM-END joint_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_components_unique
theorem joint_components_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {a b : Nat → Nat} (ha0 : a 0 = numSeed) (hb0 : b 0 = denSeed)
    (ha : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = add (mul (n + 1) (a n)) (b n))
    (hb : ∀ n, b (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (b n)) :
    ∀ n, a n = numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n ∧ b n = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have hpair : (fun n => (a n, b n)) = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
    apply joint_unique
    · exact Prod.ext ha0 hb0
    · intro n
      exact Prod.ext (ha n) (hb n)
  intro n
  have atN := congrFun hpair n
  refine ⟨congrArg Prod.fst atN, ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg Prod.snd atN).trans (joint_denominator mul add numSeed denSeed n)
-- RHGYM-END joint_components_unique

/-- A concrete finite witness, checked by kernel reduction. -/

-- RHGYM-END witness_denominator_six

theorem witness_joint_six : joint Nat.mul Nat.add 0 1 6 = (1764, 720) := by

-- RHGYM-BEGIN IsPrefix
/-- A recurrence contract through `bound`; values after `bound` are unrestricted. -/
def IsPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend
/-- Replace the next point while retaining every earlier value. -/
def extend (f : Nat → α) (bound : Nat) (value : α) : Nat → α :=

  refine ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hmn)

-- RHGYM-END glue

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_agrees
theorem glue_agrees {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    glue family i = (family n).val i := by
  exact prefix_agreement (family i).property (family n).property i (Nat.le_refl i) hi
-- RHGYM-END glue_agrees

-- RHGYM-BEGIN GluedGraph
/-- Union of the bounded graph predicates supplied by a prefix family. -/
def GluedGraph {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ n, PrefixGraph n (family n).val i value
-- RHGYM-END GluedGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glued_graph_iff
theorem glued_graph_iff {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) :
    GluedGraph family i value ↔ value = glue family i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
    exact hn.2.trans (glue_agrees family n i hn.1).symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨i, Nat.le_refl i, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END glued_graph_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_zero
theorem glue_zero {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family 0 = seed := by
  exact (family 0).property.1
-- RHGYM-END glue_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_succ
theorem glue_succ {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n : Nat) :
    glue family (n + 1) = step n (glue family n) := by
  calc
    glue family (n + 1) = step n ((family (n + 1)).val n) :=
      (family (n + 1)).property.2 n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    _ = step n (glue family n) :=
      congrArg (step n) (glue_agrees family (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)).symm
-- RHGYM-END glue_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN Recurrence
/-- The unrestricted recurrence contract. -/
def Recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ n, f (n + 1) = step n (f n)
-- RHGYM-END Recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_recurrence
theorem orbit_recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    Recurrence step seed (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_unique
theorem recurrence_unique {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {f g : Nat → α}
    (hf : Recurrence step seed f) (hg : Recurrence step seed g) : f = g := by
  funext n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [hf.2 n, hg.2 n, ih]
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_exists_unique
theorem recurrence_exists_unique (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed f ∧
      ∀ g : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed g → g = f := by
  exact ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_recurrence step seed,
    fun _ hg => recurrence_unique hg (orbit_recurrence step seed)⟩
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_exists_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_eq_orbit
theorem glue_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family = orbit step seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨glue_zero family, glue_succ family⟩ (orbit_recurrence step seed)
-- RHGYM-END glue_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator
def denominator (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  orbit (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed
-- RHGYM-END denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_zero
theorem denominator_zero (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed 0 = seed := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_succ
theorem denominator_succ (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed n : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (denominator mul seed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_unique
theorem denominator_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) :
    f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN ExactDenominatorStep
/-- Existential evaluation order analogous to frozen clause 21. -/
def ExactDenominatorStep (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, ∃ k a l b c : Nat,
    k = n + 1 ∧ a = f k ∧ l = n + 1 ∧ b = f n ∧ c = mul l b ∧ a = c
-- RHGYM-END ExactDenominatorStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_to_exact
theorem denominator_step_to_exact {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) : ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  intro n
  exact ⟨n + 1, f (n + 1), n + 1, f n, f (n + 1), rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hs n, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_to_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_to_step
theorem denominator_exact_to_step {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨k, a, l, b, c, hk, ha, hl, hb, hc, hac⟩ := h n
  calc
    f (n + 1) = f k := congrArg f hk.symm
    _ = a := ha.symm
    _ = c := hac
    _ = mul l b := hc
    _ = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by rw [hl, hb]
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_to_step

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_equiv
theorem denominator_step_equiv (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    (∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) ↔ ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  exact ⟨denominator_step_to_exact, denominator_exact_to_step⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_equiv

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact
theorem denominator_exact (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    ExactDenominatorStep mul (denominator mul seed) := by
  exact denominator_step_to_exact (denominator_succ mul seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_unique
theorem denominator_exact_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact denominator_unique h0 (denominator_exact_to_step hs)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN jointStep
def jointStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (state : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  (add (mul (n + 1) state.1) state.2, mul (n + 1) state.2)
-- RHGYM-END jointStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint
/-- Joint numerator and denominator recurrence with independent initial values. -/
def joint (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat :=
  orbit (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed)
-- RHGYM-END joint

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator
def numerator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) : Nat :=
  (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1
-- RHGYM-END numerator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_zero
theorem joint_zero (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed 0 = (numSeed, denSeed) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_succ
theorem joint_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      jointStep mul add n (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_denominator
theorem joint_denominator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have h : (fun i => (joint mul add numSeed denSeed i).2) = denominator mul denSeed :=
    denominator_unique rfl (fun _ => rfl)
  exact congrFun h n
-- RHGYM-END joint_denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator_succ
theorem numerator_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    numerator mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      add (mul (n + 1) (numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n)) (denominator mul denSeed n) := by
  change add (mul (n + 1) (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1)
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = _
  rw [joint_denominator]
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END numerator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_unique
theorem joint_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {f : Nat → Nat × Nat} (h0 : f 0 = (numSeed, denSeed))
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = jointStep mul add n (f n)) :
    f = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed))
-- RHGYM-END joint_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_components_unique
theorem joint_components_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {a b : Nat → Nat} (ha0 : a 0 = numSeed) (hb0 : b 0 = denSeed)
    (ha : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = add (mul (n + 1) (a n)) (b n))
    (hb : ∀ n, b (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (b n)) :
    ∀ n, a n = numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n ∧ b n = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have hpair : (fun n => (a n, b n)) = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
    apply joint_unique
    · exact Prod.ext ha0 hb0
    · intro n
      exact Prod.ext (ha n) (hb n)
  intro n
  have atN := congrFun hpair n
  refine ⟨congrArg Prod.fst atN, ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg Prod.snd atN).trans (joint_denominator mul add numSeed denSeed n)
-- RHGYM-END joint_components_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN witness_denominator_six
/-- A concrete finite witness, checked by kernel reduction. -/
theorem witness_denominator_six : denominator Nat.mul 1 6 = 720 := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END witness_denominator_six

-- RHGYM-BEGIN witness_joint_six
/-- The integer numerator/denominator recurrence at index six. -/
theorem witness_joint_six : joint Nat.mul Nat.add 0 1 6 = (1764, 720) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END witness_joint_six

-- RHGYM-BEGIN AffineStep
/-- Relational evaluation, including the identity branch at index zero. -/
def AffineStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (y a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  (y = 0 ∧ b = a) ∨
    ∃ x d u : Nat, y = x + 1 ∧ d = den x ∧ u = mul y a ∧ b = add u d

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affineValue

  constructor

    · exact h.2
    · cases hy
  · intro h
    exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩

        _ = add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x) := by rw [hu, hd]

    exact Or.inr ⟨x, den x, mul (x + 1) a, rfl, rfl, rfl, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_succ_iff

/-!
# RH compactification curriculum: recurrences and compatible finite prefixes

This module supplies a Lean-native mathematical analogue of the finite-prefix,
overlap, gluing, and recurrence constructions in `research/rh_pl01/`. Its domain
is Lean's `Nat`, and its graphs are predicates or functions. It does not translate
the custom Hilbert calculus, its set-theoretic encoding, or its frozen RH target.

The operation arguments `mul` and `add` are arbitrary total natural functions.
The general theorems impose no arithmetic laws on them. The final numerical
witnesses specialize both operations to Lean's natural multiplication and addition.

The marker comments delimit declarations for the proof-repair gym. A challenge
receives the declarations preceding its target and the target's statement.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FeedbackChannel.RHCompactification

universe u
variable {α : Type u}

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit
/-- Primitive recursion with a step indexed by its predecessor. -/
def orbit (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) : Nat → α
  | 0 => seed
  | n + 1 => step n (orbit step seed n)
-- RHGYM-END orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN IsPrefix
/-- A recurrence contract through `bound`; values after `bound` are unrestricted. -/
def IsPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ i, i < bound → f (i + 1) = step i (f i)
-- RHGYM-END IsPrefix

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend
/-- Replace the next point while retaining every earlier value. -/
def extend (f : Nat → α) (bound : Nat) (value : α) : Nat → α :=
  fun i => if i = bound + 1 then value else f i
-- RHGYM-END extend

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend_at_new
theorem extend_at_new (f : Nat → α) (bound : Nat) (value : α) :
    extend f bound value (bound + 1) = value := by
  simp [extend]
-- RHGYM-END extend_at_new

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend_before
theorem extend_before (f : Nat → α) (bound i : Nat) (value : α)
    (hi : i ≤ bound) : extend f bound value i = f i := by
  have hne : i ≠ bound + 1 := Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi)
  simp [extend, hne]
-- RHGYM-END extend_before

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_zero
theorem prefix_zero (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    IsPrefix step seed 0 (fun _ => seed) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_restrict
theorem prefix_restrict {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {m n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hmn : m ≤ n) : IsPrefix step seed m f := by
  refine ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hmn)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_restrict

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_extend
theorem prefix_extend {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) :
    IsPrefix step seed (n + 1) (extend f n (step n (f n))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [extend_before f n 0 (step n (f n)) (Nat.zero_le n)]
    exact hf.1
  · intro i hi
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi) with hlt | heq
    · rw [extend_before f n (i + 1) (step n (f n)) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt)]
      rw [extend_before f n i (step n (f n)) (Nat.le_of_lt hlt)]
      exact hf.2 i hlt
    · subst i
      rw [extend_at_new, extend_before f n n (step n (f n)) (Nat.le_refl n)]
-- RHGYM-END prefix_extend

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_agreement
/-- Independently chosen prefixes agree at every index in both domains. -/
theorem prefix_agreement {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n m : Nat}
    {f g : Nat → α} (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hg : IsPrefix step seed m g)
    (i : Nat) (hin : i ≤ n) (him : i ≤ m) : f i = g i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ i ih =>
      rw [hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hin), hg.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le him)]
      exact congrArg (step i)
        (ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) hin) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) him))
-- RHGYM-END prefix_agreement

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_isPrefix
theorem orbit_isPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    IsPrefix step seed n (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_isPrefix

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_eq_orbit
theorem prefix_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) : f i = orbit step seed i := by
  exact prefix_agreement hf (orbit_isPrefix step seed n) i hi hi
-- RHGYM-END prefix_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_exists
/-- Finite existence follows by repeated checked extension. -/
theorem prefix_exists (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, IsPrefix step seed n f := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => seed, prefix_zero step seed⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨extend f n (step n (f n)), prefix_extend hf⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_exists

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixGraph
/-- A graph predicate whose domain is exactly the finite initial segment. -/
def PrefixGraph (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  i ≤ bound ∧ value = f i
-- RHGYM-END PrefixGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_domain
theorem prefix_graph_domain (bound i : Nat) (f : Nat → α) :
    (∃ value, PrefixGraph bound f i value) ↔ i ≤ bound := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨value, hv⟩ := h
    exact hv.1
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨f i, hi, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_domain

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_functional
theorem prefix_graph_functional {bound i : Nat} {f : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (ha : PrefixGraph bound f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph bound f i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans hb.2.symm
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_functional

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_overlap
theorem prefix_graph_overlap {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n m i : Nat}
    {f g : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hg : IsPrefix step seed m g)
    (ha : PrefixGraph n f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph m g i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans ((prefix_agreement hf hg i ha.1 hb.1).trans hb.2.symm)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_overlap

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixFamily
/-- The family supplies an explicit prefix at every endpoint. -/
def PrefixFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :=
  (n : Nat) → {f : Nat → α // IsPrefix step seed n f}
-- RHGYM-END PrefixFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN canonicalFamily
def canonicalFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) : PrefixFamily step seed :=
  fun n => ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_isPrefix step seed n⟩
-- RHGYM-END canonicalFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue
/-- The diagonal chooses the endpoint value of the corresponding prefix. -/
def glue {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : Nat → α :=
  fun i => (family i).val i
-- RHGYM-END glue

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_agrees
theorem glue_agrees {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    glue family i = (family n).val i := by
  exact prefix_agreement (family i).property (family n).property i (Nat.le_refl i) hi
-- RHGYM-END glue_agrees

-- RHGYM-BEGIN GluedGraph
/-- Union of the bounded graph predicates supplied by a prefix family. -/
def GluedGraph {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ n, PrefixGraph n (family n).val i value
-- RHGYM-END GluedGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glued_graph_iff
theorem glued_graph_iff {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) :
    GluedGraph family i value ↔ value = glue family i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
    exact hn.2.trans (glue_agrees family n i hn.1).symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨i, Nat.le_refl i, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END glued_graph_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_zero
theorem glue_zero {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family 0 = seed := by
  exact (family 0).property.1
-- RHGYM-END glue_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_succ
theorem glue_succ {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n : Nat) :
    glue family (n + 1) = step n (glue family n) := by
  calc
    glue family (n + 1) = step n ((family (n + 1)).val n) :=
      (family (n + 1)).property.2 n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    _ = step n (glue family n) :=
      congrArg (step n) (glue_agrees family (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)).symm
-- RHGYM-END glue_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN Recurrence
/-- The unrestricted recurrence contract. -/
def Recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ n, f (n + 1) = step n (f n)
-- RHGYM-END Recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_recurrence
theorem orbit_recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    Recurrence step seed (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_unique
theorem recurrence_unique {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {f g : Nat → α}
    (hf : Recurrence step seed f) (hg : Recurrence step seed g) : f = g := by
  funext n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [hf.2 n, hg.2 n, ih]
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_exists_unique
theorem recurrence_exists_unique (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed f ∧
      ∀ g : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed g → g = f := by
  exact ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_recurrence step seed,
    fun _ hg => recurrence_unique hg (orbit_recurrence step seed)⟩
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_exists_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_eq_orbit
theorem glue_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family = orbit step seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨glue_zero family, glue_succ family⟩ (orbit_recurrence step seed)
-- RHGYM-END glue_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator
def denominator (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  orbit (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed
-- RHGYM-END denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_zero
theorem denominator_zero (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed 0 = seed := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_succ
theorem denominator_succ (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed n : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (denominator mul seed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_unique
theorem denominator_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) :
    f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN ExactDenominatorStep
/-- Existential evaluation order analogous to frozen clause 21. -/
def ExactDenominatorStep (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, ∃ k a l b c : Nat,
    k = n + 1 ∧ a = f k ∧ l = n + 1 ∧ b = f n ∧ c = mul l b ∧ a = c
-- RHGYM-END ExactDenominatorStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_to_exact
theorem denominator_step_to_exact {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) : ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  intro n
  exact ⟨n + 1, f (n + 1), n + 1, f n, f (n + 1), rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hs n, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_to_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_to_step
theorem denominator_exact_to_step {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨k, a, l, b, c, hk, ha, hl, hb, hc, hac⟩ := h n
  calc
    f (n + 1) = f k := congrArg f hk.symm
    _ = a := ha.symm
    _ = c := hac
    _ = mul l b := hc
    _ = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by rw [hl, hb]
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_to_step

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_equiv
theorem denominator_step_equiv (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    (∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) ↔ ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  exact ⟨denominator_step_to_exact, denominator_exact_to_step⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_equiv

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact
theorem denominator_exact (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    ExactDenominatorStep mul (denominator mul seed) := by
  exact denominator_step_to_exact (denominator_succ mul seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_unique
theorem denominator_exact_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ExactDenominatorStep mul f) : f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact denominator_unique h0 (denominator_exact_to_step hs)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN jointStep
def jointStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (state : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  (add (mul (n + 1) state.1) state.2, mul (n + 1) state.2)
-- RHGYM-END jointStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint
/-- Joint numerator and denominator recurrence with independent initial values. -/
def joint (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat :=
  orbit (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed)
-- RHGYM-END joint

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator
def numerator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) : Nat :=
  (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1
-- RHGYM-END numerator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_zero
theorem joint_zero (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed 0 = (numSeed, denSeed) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_succ
theorem joint_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      jointStep mul add n (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_denominator
theorem joint_denominator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have h : (fun i => (joint mul add numSeed denSeed i).2) = denominator mul denSeed :=
    denominator_unique rfl (fun _ => rfl)
  exact congrFun h n
-- RHGYM-END joint_denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator_succ
theorem numerator_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    numerator mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =
      add (mul (n + 1) (numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n)) (denominator mul denSeed n) := by
  change add (mul (n + 1) (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1)
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = _
  rw [joint_denominator]
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END numerator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_unique
theorem joint_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {f : Nat → Nat × Nat} (h0 : f 0 = (numSeed, denSeed))
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = jointStep mul add n (f n)) :
    f = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed))
-- RHGYM-END joint_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_components_unique
theorem joint_components_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {a b : Nat → Nat} (ha0 : a 0 = numSeed) (hb0 : b 0 = denSeed)
    (ha : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = add (mul (n + 1) (a n)) (b n))
    (hb : ∀ n, b (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (b n)) :
    ∀ n, a n = numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n ∧ b n = denominator mul denSeed n := by
  have hpair : (fun n => (a n, b n)) = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
    apply joint_unique
    · exact Prod.ext ha0 hb0
    · intro n
      exact Prod.ext (ha n) (hb n)
  intro n
  have atN := congrFun hpair n
  refine ⟨congrArg Prod.fst atN, ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg Prod.snd atN).trans (joint_denominator mul add numSeed denSeed n)
-- RHGYM-END joint_components_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN witness_denominator_six
/-- A concrete finite witness, checked by kernel reduction. -/
theorem witness_denominator_six : denominator Nat.mul 1 6 = 720 := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END witness_denominator_six

-- RHGYM-BEGIN witness_joint_six
/-- The integer numerator/denominator recurrence at index six. -/
theorem witness_joint_six : joint Nat.mul Nat.add 0 1 6 = (1764, 720) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END witness_joint_six

This module extends the recurrence curriculum using only the existing
`RHCompactification` module and its `Init` dependencies. The operation arguments
`mul`, `add`, and `den` are arbitrary total functions on Lean's `Nat`. No
arithmetic laws or recurrence equation for `den` are assumed by the step graph
or recurrence existence theorems.

The relation follows the RH-PL-18 construction: index zero returns the old value;
at a successor index it evaluates the predecessor's denominator, multiplies the
old value by the successor index, and adds that denominator. The final theorem
specializes `den` to the previously constructed denominator and identifies the
result with the joint numerator.

These are Lean Nat/function analogues. The custom Hilbert graph encoding and its
set-theoretic proof certificates retain their separate verifier and provenance.
Every obligation belongs to the existing public recurrence training family.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FeedbackChannel.RHNumeratorStep

open FeedbackChannel.RHCompactification

-- RHGYM-BEGIN AffineStep
/-- Relational evaluation, including the identity branch at index zero. -/
def AffineStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (y a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  (y = 0 ∧ b = a) ∨
    ∃ x d u : Nat, y = x + 1 ∧ d = den x ∧ u = mul y a ∧ b = add u d
-- RHGYM-END AffineStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affineValue
/-- The total function represented by `AffineStep`. -/
def affineValue (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, a => a
  | x + 1, a => add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x)
-- RHGYM-END affineValue

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affine_step_zero_iff
theorem affine_step_zero_iff (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (a b : Nat) : AffineStep mul add den 0 a b ↔ b = a := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | ⟨x, d, u, hy, hd, hu, hb⟩
    · exact h.2
    · cases hy
  · intro h
    exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_zero_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affine_step_succ_iff
/-- At a successor, every intermediate witness reduces to the affine update. -/
theorem affine_step_succ_iff (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (x a b : Nat) :
    AffineStep mul add den (x + 1) a b ↔ b = add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | ⟨z, d, u, hy, hd, hu, hb⟩
    · cases h.1
    · have hxz : x = z := Nat.succ.inj hy
      subst z
      calc
        b = add u d := hb
        _ = add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x) := by rw [hu, hd]
  · intro h
    exact Or.inr ⟨x, den x, mul (x + 1) a, rfl, rfl, rfl, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_succ_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affine_step_iff_graph
/-- The relational and deterministic presentations have the same graph. -/
theorem affine_step_iff_graph (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (y a b : Nat) : AffineStep mul add den y a b ↔ b = affineValue mul add den y a := by
  cases y with
  | zero => exact affine_step_zero_iff mul add den a b
  | succ x => exact affine_step_succ_iff mul add den x a b
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_iff_graph

/-!
# RH compactification curriculum: recurrences and compatible finite prefixes

This module supplies a Lean-native mathematical analogue of the finite-prefix,
overlap, gluing, and recurrence constructions in `research/rh_pl01/`. Its domain
is Lean's `Nat`, and its graphs are predicates or functions. It does not translate
the custom Hilbert calculus, its set-theoretic encoding, or its frozen RH target.

The operation arguments `mul` and `add` are arbitrary total natural functions.
The general theorems impose no arithmetic laws on them. The final numerical
witnesses specialize both operations to Lean's natural multiplication and addition.

The marker comments delimit declarations for the proof-repair gym. A challenge
receives the declarations preceding its target and the target's statement.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FeedbackChannel.RHCompactification

universe u
variable {α : Type u}

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit
/-- Primitive recursion with a step indexed by its predecessor. -/
def orbit (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) : Nat → α
  | 0 => seed
  | n + 1 => step n (orbit step seed n)
-- RHGYM-END orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN IsPrefix
/-- A recurrence contract through `bound`; values after `bound` are unrestricted. -/
def IsPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ i, i < bound → f (i + 1) = step i (f i)
-- RHGYM-END IsPrefix

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend
/-- Replace the next point while retaining every earlier value. -/
def extend (f : Nat → α) (bound : Nat) (value : α) : Nat → α :=
  fun i => if i = bound + 1 then value else f i
-- RHGYM-END extend

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend_at_new
theorem extend_at_new (f : Nat → α) (bound : Nat) (value : α) :
    extend f bound value (bound + 1) = value := by
  simp [extend]
-- RHGYM-END extend_at_new

-- RHGYM-BEGIN extend_before
theorem extend_before (f : Nat → α) (bound i : Nat) (value : α)
    (hi : i ≤ bound) : extend f bound value i = f i := by
  have hne : i ≠ bound + 1 := Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi)
  simp [extend, hne]
-- RHGYM-END extend_before

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_zero
theorem prefix_zero (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    IsPrefix step seed 0 (fun _ => seed) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_restrict
theorem prefix_restrict {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {m n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hmn : m ≤ n) : IsPrefix step seed m f := by
  refine ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hmn)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_restrict

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_extend
theorem prefix_extend {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) :
    IsPrefix step seed (n + 1) (extend f n (step n (f n))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [extend_before f n 0 (step n (f n)) (Nat.zero_le n)]
    exact hf.1
  · intro i hi
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi) with hlt | heq
    · rw [extend_before f n (i + 1) (step n (f n)) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt)]
      rw [extend_before f n i (step n (f n)) (Nat.le_of_lt hlt)]
      exact hf.2 i hlt
    · subst i
      rw [extend_at_new, extend_before f n n (step n (f n)) (Nat.le_refl n)]
-- RHGYM-END prefix_extend

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_agreement
/-- Independently chosen prefixes agree at every index in both domains. -/
theorem prefix_agreement {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n m : Nat}
    {f g : Nat → α} (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hg : IsPrefix step seed m g)
    (i : Nat) (hin : i ≤ n) (him : i ≤ m) : f i = g i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ i ih =>
      rw [hf.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hin), hg.2 i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le him)]
      exact congrArg (step i)
        (ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) hin) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ i) him))
-- RHGYM-END prefix_agreement

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_isPrefix
theorem orbit_isPrefix (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    IsPrefix step seed n (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_isPrefix

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_eq_orbit
theorem prefix_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n : Nat} {f : Nat → α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) : f i = orbit step seed i := by
  exact prefix_agreement hf (orbit_isPrefix step seed n) i hi hi
-- RHGYM-END prefix_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_exists
/-- Finite existence follows by repeated checked extension. -/
theorem prefix_exists (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, IsPrefix step seed n f := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => seed, prefix_zero step seed⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨extend f n (step n (f n)), prefix_extend hf⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_exists

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixGraph
/-- A graph predicate whose domain is exactly the finite initial segment. -/
def PrefixGraph (bound : Nat) (f : Nat → α) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  i ≤ bound ∧ value = f i
-- RHGYM-END PrefixGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_domain
theorem prefix_graph_domain (bound i : Nat) (f : Nat → α) :
    (∃ value, PrefixGraph bound f i value) ↔ i ≤ bound := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨value, hv⟩ := h
    exact hv.1
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨f i, hi, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_domain

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_functional
theorem prefix_graph_functional {bound i : Nat} {f : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (ha : PrefixGraph bound f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph bound f i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans hb.2.symm
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_functional

-- RHGYM-BEGIN prefix_graph_overlap
theorem prefix_graph_overlap {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {n m i : Nat}
    {f g : Nat → α} {a b : α}
    (hf : IsPrefix step seed n f) (hg : IsPrefix step seed m g)
    (ha : PrefixGraph n f i a) (hb : PrefixGraph m g i b) : a = b := by
  exact ha.2.trans ((prefix_agreement hf hg i ha.1 hb.1).trans hb.2.symm)
-- RHGYM-END prefix_graph_overlap

-- RHGYM-BEGIN PrefixFamily
/-- The family supplies an explicit prefix at every endpoint. -/
def PrefixFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :=
  (n : Nat) → {f : Nat → α // IsPrefix step seed n f}
-- RHGYM-END PrefixFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN canonicalFamily
def canonicalFamily (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) : PrefixFamily step seed :=
  fun n => ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_isPrefix step seed n⟩
-- RHGYM-END canonicalFamily

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue
/-- The diagonal chooses the endpoint value of the corresponding prefix. -/
def glue {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : Nat → α :=
  fun i => (family i).val i
-- RHGYM-END glue

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_agrees
theorem glue_agrees {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    glue family i = (family n).val i := by
  exact prefix_agreement (family i).property (family n).property i (Nat.le_refl i) hi
-- RHGYM-END glue_agrees

-- RHGYM-BEGIN GluedGraph
/-- Union of the bounded graph predicates supplied by a prefix family. -/
def GluedGraph {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ n, PrefixGraph n (family n).val i value
-- RHGYM-END GluedGraph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glued_graph_iff
theorem glued_graph_iff {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (i : Nat) (value : α) :
    GluedGraph family i value ↔ value = glue family i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
    exact hn.2.trans (glue_agrees family n i hn.1).symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨i, Nat.le_refl i, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END glued_graph_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_zero
theorem glue_zero {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family 0 = seed := by
  exact (family 0).property.1
-- RHGYM-END glue_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_succ
theorem glue_succ {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) (n : Nat) :
    glue family (n + 1) = step n (glue family n) := by
  calc
    glue family (n + 1) = step n ((family (n + 1)).val n) :=
      (family (n + 1)).property.2 n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    _ = step n (glue family n) :=
      congrArg (step n) (glue_agrees family (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)).symm
-- RHGYM-END glue_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN Recurrence
/-- The unrestricted recurrence contract. -/
def Recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) (f : Nat → α) : Prop :=
  f 0 = seed ∧ ∀ n, f (n + 1) = step n (f n)
-- RHGYM-END Recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN orbit_recurrence
theorem orbit_recurrence (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    Recurrence step seed (orbit step seed) := by
  exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END orbit_recurrence

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_unique
theorem recurrence_unique {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α} {f g : Nat → α}
    (hf : Recurrence step seed f) (hg : Recurrence step seed g) : f = g := by
  funext n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hf.1.trans hg.1.symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [hf.2 n, hg.2 n, ih]
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN recurrence_exists_unique
theorem recurrence_exists_unique (step : Nat → α → α) (seed : α) :
    ∃ f : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed f ∧
      ∀ g : Nat → α, Recurrence step seed g → g = f := by
  exact ⟨orbit step seed, orbit_recurrence step seed,
    fun _ hg => recurrence_unique hg (orbit_recurrence step seed)⟩
-- RHGYM-END recurrence_exists_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN glue_eq_orbit
theorem glue_eq_orbit {step : Nat → α → α} {seed : α}
    (family : PrefixFamily step seed) : glue family = orbit step seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨glue_zero family, glue_succ family⟩ (orbit_recurrence step seed)
-- RHGYM-END glue_eq_orbit

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator
def denominator (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  orbit (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed
-- RHGYM-END denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_zero
theorem denominator_zero (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed 0 = seed := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_succ
theorem denominator_succ (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (seed n : Nat) :
    denominator mul seed (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (denominator mul seed n) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END denominator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_unique
theorem denominator_unique {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {seed : Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (h0 : f 0 = seed) (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) :
    f = denominator mul seed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (fun n value => mul (n + 1) value) seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN ExactDenominatorStep
/-- Existential evaluation order analogous to frozen clause 21. -/
def ExactDenominatorStep (mul : Nat → Nat → Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, ∃ k a l b c : Nat,
    k = n + 1 ∧ a = f k ∧ l = n + 1 ∧ b = f n ∧ c = mul l b ∧ a = c
-- RHGYM-END ExactDenominatorStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_to_exact
theorem denominator_step_to_exact {mul : Nat → Nat → Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (f n)) : ExactDenominatorStep mul f := by
  intro n
  exact ⟨n + 1, f (n + 1), n + 1, f n, f (n + 1), rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hs n, rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_to_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_to_step

  intro n
  obtain ⟨k, a, l, b, c, hk, ha, hl, hb, hc, hac⟩ := h n
  calc
    f (n + 1) = f k := congrArg f hk.symm
    _ = a := ha.symm
    _ = c := hac
    _ = mul l b := hc
    _ = mul (n + 1) (f n) := by rw [hl, hb]
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_to_step

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_step_equiv

  exact ⟨denominator_step_to_exact, denominator_exact_to_step⟩
-- RHGYM-END denominator_step_equiv

  exact denominator_step_to_exact (denominator_succ mul seed)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact

-- RHGYM-BEGIN denominator_exact_unique

  exact denominator_unique h0 (denominator_exact_to_step hs)
-- RHGYM-END denominator_exact_unique

-- RHGYM-BEGIN jointStep
def jointStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (state : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  (add (mul (n + 1) state.1) state.2, mul (n + 1) state.2)
-- RHGYM-END jointStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint
/-- Joint numerator and denominator recurrence with independent initial values. -/
def joint (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat :=
  orbit (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed)
-- RHGYM-END joint

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator

  (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1
-- RHGYM-END numerator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_zero
theorem joint_zero (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed 0 = (numSeed, denSeed) := by
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_zero

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_succ
theorem joint_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :
    joint mul add numSeed denSeed (n + 1) =

  rfl
-- RHGYM-END joint_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_denominator
theorem joint_denominator (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :

  have h : (fun i => (joint mul add numSeed denSeed i).2) = denominator mul denSeed :=
    denominator_unique rfl (fun _ => rfl)

-- RHGYM-END joint_denominator

-- RHGYM-BEGIN numerator_succ
theorem numerator_succ (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (numSeed denSeed n : Nat) :

      add (mul (n + 1) (numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n)) (denominator mul denSeed n) := by
  change add (mul (n + 1) (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).1)
    (joint mul add numSeed denSeed n).2 = _
  rw [joint_denominator]
  rfl
-- RHGYM-END numerator_succ

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_unique
theorem joint_unique {mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat} {numSeed denSeed : Nat}
    {f : Nat → Nat × Nat} (h0 : f 0 = (numSeed, denSeed))
    (hs : ∀ n, f (n + 1) = jointStep mul add n (f n)) :
    f = joint mul add numSeed denSeed := by
  exact recurrence_unique ⟨h0, hs⟩ (orbit_recurrence (jointStep mul add) (numSeed, denSeed))

-- RHGYM-BEGIN joint_components_unique

    (ha : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = add (mul (n + 1) (a n)) (b n))
    (hb : ∀ n, b (n + 1) = mul (n + 1) (b n)) :
    ∀ n, a n = numerator mul add numSeed denSeed n ∧ b n = denominator mul denSeed n := by

    · intro n
      exact Prod.ext (ha n) (hb n)

  have atN := congrFun hpair n
  refine ⟨congrArg Prod.fst atN, ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg Prod.snd atN).trans (joint_denominator mul add numSeed denSeed n)
-- RHGYM-END joint_components_unique

This module extends the recurrence curriculum using only the existing
`RHCompactification` module and its `Init` dependencies. The operation arguments
`mul`, `add`, and `den` are arbitrary total functions on Lean's `Nat`. No
arithmetic laws or recurrence equation for `den` are assumed by the step graph
or recurrence existence theorems.

The relation follows the RH-PL-18 construction: index zero returns the old value;
at a successor index it evaluates the predecessor's denominator, multiplies the
old value by the successor index, and adds that denominator. The final theorem
specializes `den` to the previously constructed denominator and identifies the
result with the joint numerator.

These are Lean Nat/function analogues. The custom Hilbert graph encoding and its
set-theoretic proof certificates retain their separate verifier and provenance.
Every obligation belongs to the existing public recurrence training family.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FeedbackChannel.RHNumeratorStep

open FeedbackChannel.RHCompactification

-- RHGYM-BEGIN AffineStep
/-- Relational evaluation, including the identity branch at index zero. -/
def AffineStep (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (y a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  (y = 0 ∧ b = a) ∨
    ∃ x d u : Nat, y = x + 1 ∧ d = den x ∧ u = mul y a ∧ b = add u d
-- RHGYM-END AffineStep

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affineValue
/-- The total function represented by `AffineStep`. -/
def affineValue (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, a => a
  | x + 1, a => add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x)
-- RHGYM-END affineValue

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affine_step_zero_iff
theorem affine_step_zero_iff (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (a b : Nat) : AffineStep mul add den 0 a b ↔ b = a := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | ⟨x, d, u, hy, hd, hu, hb⟩
    · exact h.2
    · cases hy
  · intro h
    exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_zero_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affine_step_succ_iff
/-- At a successor, every intermediate witness reduces to the affine update. -/
theorem affine_step_succ_iff (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (x a b : Nat) :
    AffineStep mul add den (x + 1) a b ↔ b = add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | ⟨z, d, u, hy, hd, hu, hb⟩
    · cases h.1
    · have hxz : x = z := Nat.succ.inj hy
      subst z
      calc
        b = add u d := hb
        _ = add (mul (x + 1) a) (den x) := by rw [hu, hd]
  · intro h
    exact Or.inr ⟨x, den x, mul (x + 1) a, rfl, rfl, rfl, h⟩
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_succ_iff

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affine_step_iff_graph
/-- The relational and deterministic presentations have the same graph. -/
theorem affine_step_iff_graph (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (y a b : Nat) : AffineStep mul add den y a b ↔ b = affineValue mul add den y a := by
  cases y with
  | zero => exact affine_step_zero_iff mul add den a b
  | succ x => exact affine_step_succ_iff mul add den x a b
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_iff_graph

-- RHGYM-BEGIN affine_step_total
theorem affine_step_total (mul add : Nat → Nat → Nat) (den : Nat → Nat)
    (y a : Nat) : ∃ b : Nat, AffineStep mul add den y a b := by
  exact ⟨affineValue mul add den y a,
    (affine_step_iff_graph mul add den y a (affineValue mul add den y a)).mpr rfl⟩
-- RHGYM-END affine_step_total

/-!
# RH compactification curriculum: recurrences and compatible finite prefixes

This module supplies a Lean-native mathematical analogue of the finite-prefix,
overlap, gluing, and recurrence constructions in `research/rh_pl01/`. Its domain
is Lean's `Nat`, and its graphs are predicates or functions. It does not translate
the custom Hilbert calculus, its set-theoretic encoding, or its frozen RH target.

The operation arguments `mul` and `add` are arbitrary total natural functions.
The general theorems impose no arithmetic laws on them. The final numerical
witnesses specialize both operations to Lean's natural multiplication and addition.

The marker comments delimit declarations for the proof-repair gym. A challenge
receives the declarations preceding its target and the target's statement.
